title: Installation Profile — v1
description: The venue document (C1, ratified 2026-08-22; design: docs/plans/2026-07-09-phase3-1-installation-profile.md §1): what is INSTALLED for one event and how the pack's abstract names bind to physical things. ENGINE-side config, never pack content — homed here per owner answer OQ6 (slice 4); loaded frozen at boot by profileService through the PROFILE_PATH seam. v1 engine reads kind/schemaVersion/profileId/forPack/bindings.lighting only; the other sections are the ratified C1 shape, typed for authoring-time typo catch and consumed by C2/C3 (resolution, preflight) as they build. Interiors marked open (endpoints) get pinned by the slice that consumes them. Venue details never enter the pack; pack content never names venue instruments.

forPack.description: Optional pack pin; tooling warns on mismatch, never refuses.

network.description: Network posture (2026-07-09 decision). kit-network is standard: the kit carries its own router, the orchestrator Pi has a reserved IP and answers the public DNS name on the LAN. venue-wifi is the fallback; its dynamic-DNS fields arrive with the Track-E E2 build (schema evolution).

orchestrator.description: The stack is ONE switch (kit-model decision): true means every stack service is expected live and absence of any is a FAULT; false is the scanners-only tier zero.

endpoints.description: The physical dials: what equipment is installed tonight. Absence = DORMANT by configuration, never an error (C2/C3 semantics). Interior shape stays open in v1 — C2 (resolution) pins it when it becomes the consumer.

bindings.description: B8: pack lighting roles → venue instruments. Keys must be declared in the pack's game.json lightingRoles (tooling/preflight check, not expressible here). v1 drives the ha provider only; WLED and friends are schema-evolution headroom.

ha.description: A concrete Home Assistant scene id, e.g. 'scene.police_1'. Concrete instrument names live HERE, never in pack cues.

audio.description: B7: venue audio config (routes + ducking stay venue, never pack).

env.description: The venue-owned slice of .env (network/infra keys only; game-scoped keys live in game.json per B11). null = use the engine default.
